series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified. The について and にとって contrast-side items are jlpt 3 (Bunpro N3). The two のは items are jlpt 5 because their only N3 option (かは) is malformed in that slot.

primarySources.use: N3 (Lesson 1) によって／による: means, depending on, cause, passive agent; によって/により before a clause, による before a noun or clause-final.
N3 (Lesson 2) に基づいて／に基づき／に基づいた／に基づく: based on a source.
N3 (Lesson 2) 点: V/い-adj + 点, な-adj + な点, N + の点, phrase + という点; often 点で.
N3 (Lesson 3) は〜で有名: N + で, clause + こと／の + で.
N3 (Lesson 3) に合わせて (adjust to) and に合った／に合う + noun (suited to).
N3 (Lesson 4) question clause + かは〜によって違う／による; かどうかは and A か B かは.
N3 (Lesson 4) と関係がある／関係がない.
N3 (Lesson 5) から言うと／から言えば: from the standpoint of; does not follow a person directly (立場から言うと).
N3 (Lesson 6) で言うと: in terms of a wording or scale (一言で言うと, 人間の年齢で言うと).
N3 (Lesson 8) において (formal in/at) and における + noun.
N3 (Lesson 9) V とおり(に)／N のとおり／N どおり: just as.
N5 (Lesson 4) のは／のが nominalizer: owning level of the のは contrast side.

supplementarySources.supports: Row statuses and existing exercise IDs for rows 62, 81, 82, 102 and 196.

dispositions.note: Three senses by interpretation (varies by case, means, cause) and the によって／による slot choice. The passive-agent sense is explained in the article only (no existing passive exercise uses によって). により accepted for the connective slot; kana always accepted; a kanji spelling (依る, 因る, 拠る) is accepted only when it matches the item's sense, as one identical instruction states.

Contrasted with に合わせて／に合った; どおり appears as a distractor only where the meaning rules it out (experience-advice). Two-option basis inventories never contain どおり, and each option subset has more than one key; the three-option inventory is keyed to all three sides (experience-advice, piano-song, forecast).
Attachment (点／な点; という点 accepted) and scope reading (という点では／の点では limit a claim to one respect). N + の点 appears in an interpretation item only.
Interpretation of で (what for versus where/among whom) and noun + で versus clause + ことで (ので accepted). として有名 is mentioned in the article only (として belongs to comparison-role-relations).
に合う + noun accepted where に合った is the answer.
Covered elsewhere. The three new について items are the contrast side required by the field-or-topic relationship (validator: every relationship construction must be targeted); jlpt 3.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (Lesson 4), page inspected 2026-11-17; のは is Bunpro N5 (Lesson 4)
dispositions.note: Question clause + かは versus statement + のは. The two のは items (basis-field-viewpoint-morning-run-noha, basis-field-viewpoint-nine-close-noha) keep jlpt 5 (owning level of のは): their only N3 option, かは, is malformed after a statement clause, so the complete visible decision does not require the N3 contrast (docs/jlpt-levels.md, malformed distractors do not raise the level). The sentence-final による variant is practised in weather-depends-yoru.
NEWL light entry: 4 items, polarity decided by context.
Covered elsewhere; the field group links to compound-forms. No new exercises.
Covered elsewhere; linked via compound-roles. No new exercises.

Contrasted with にとって (which follows a person) and で言うと (restating in another category or scale); から言えば accepted. The pair {で言うと, から言うと} is offered only together with にとって (dog-age, my-happiness), never as a two-option inventory, because 親の立場で言うと-type uses are common in speech.

Covered elsewhere. Four new にとって items are the contrast side required by the viewpoint relationship (two use にとっての + noun, so that で言うと also appears as a distractor and the {で言うと, にとって} inventory has one item keyed to each side); jlpt 3.
Wording (一言) and conversion scales (human age, currency).
で is never offered as a distractor (it is also correct for places); the instruction restricts the typed set.

Existing toori items keep their labels (Rule A). New items add the N3 'just as said/expected' sense with N どおり (V とおり is explained in the article only); ように is never offered as a distractor because it is also valid. n5-particles-route-bridge and n5-particles-route-park were dropped from reuse: they were lexical-search false positives from the brief (their prompts are about routes, not とおり), so 2 reused items remain.

groups.reason: によって is a compound particle relation; it sits with the existing compound relations.
Slot choice for によって／による and かは〜によって違う builds on the same relation.
Basis and matching relations are noun-role relations.
Noun-modifying forms of the basis relations.
において／における and について are compound relations next to compound-forms.
Viewpoint relations sit beside にとって in compound-relations.
点 limits a statement to a respect; close to the viewpoint group.
で有名 is a noun-role (で) frame.
と関係がある is a relation between two nouns.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.
